updates.title: Tool registry prescribes deleting go.dev tarball installs on Linux; 'Install cleanup' rule has no install-before-cleanup ordering
updates.reason: Five more scripts remove a non-preferred install before the replacement is installed and verified, the ordering #55 names: setup-rust.sh:33 `brew uninstall rust` before the rustup install (:61); setup-vercelcli.sh:97 `npm uninstall -g vercel` before `brew install vercel-cli` (:103); setup-go.ps1:29 `choco uninstall golang -y` before `winget install` (:103); setup-pandoc.sh:93-109 remove_package (conda, port, cabal) before `brew install pandoc` (:112); setup-datadog.sh:35 `brew uninstall datadog/pack/pup` before the reinstall (:84, :116). Spec: plans/linux-install-hardening.md:30 F1 'Install first, clean up second'. Source: S4-Review report section 4 (M2 I-01, '7 scripts remove before verify'); re-verified by S3-Ledger grep.
updates.observationAppend: UPDATED 2026-10-21 (S3-Ledger, origin/main c8573ed): the same remove-before-verify ordering is in setup-rust.sh:33, setup-vercelcli.sh:97, setup-go.ps1:29, setup-pandoc.sh:93-109 and setup-datadog.sh:35 (S5-Tools I-01).
